items.title: Jack Palmer interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, September 24, 1997
items.q: he needed Molly, my wife, to drive his car.

ctx.x: Yeah. I didn’t speak to him for two months. I didn’t. I told him off and I didn’t speak to him. I says, “Just stay away from me, I don’t want to.” And we had been roommates you know? But we got together. Because now it came time to leave California, so he started romancing me because he needed Molly, my wife, to drive his car. Nancy couldn’t drive you see? He was a schemer.
What kind of car was it?
